provenance.paper_title: SKILL.nb: Selective Formalization and Gated Execution for Durable Agent Workflows

representation_paths.memory_component: versioned notebook screenshots, outputs, and error traces

evidence.paraphrase: Versioned workflow notebooks preserve code, outputs, screenshots, and error traces that support later maintenance and validation.
Natural-language instructions, executable code, visual outputs, validation evidence, and lifecycle metadata are organized as versioned durable workflows and loaded for repeated execution.
Runtime failures and local repairs generate proposals that maintenance can refactor, validate, and promote as new workflow versions.
Repository maintenance can consolidate duplicate workflow variants before promotion.
Evidence-calibrated lifecycle gates promote, demote, release, or retire workflow versions.
Execution failures and validated repairs persistently revise versioned workflow procedures; promoted versions replace earlier procedures for later repeated multimodal workflow executions.

derived.hybrid_relation: Source-preserving screenshots and outputs remain linked to the executable versioned workflow that they validate.

adjudication_notes: Strict T3 is supported by the failure-to-repair-to-promotion-to-later-execution chain. Fixed lifecycle thresholds alone are not treated as policy evolution; the qualifying artifact is the revised reusable workflow procedure.
